```artifact
Following is the corrected test suite written in Finite State Machines / Statecharts notation:

```
Statechart {
  initial: "Idle",
  states: [
    "Idle",
    "AlarmTriggered",
    "AlarmInhibited",
    "AlarmAcknowledged",
    "AlarmCancelled",
    "AlarmReset",
    "AlarmSet",
    "AlarmFiredForBreaths",
    "AlarmFiredLeakage"
  ],
  transitions: [
    { "from": "Idle", "to": "AlarmTriggered", "event": "AlarmOccurrence" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmInhibited", "event": "InhibitAlarm", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmAcknowledged", "event": "AcknowledgeAlarm", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmCancelled", "event": "CancelAlarm", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmReset", "event": "ResetAlarm", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmSet", "event": "SetAlarm", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmFiredForBreaths", "event": "FiredForBreaths", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmTriggered", "to": "AlarmFiredLeakage", "event": "FiredLeakage", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmFiredForBreaths", "to": "Idle", "event": "BreathEnd", "guard": "true" },
    { "from": "AlarmFiredLeakage", "to": "Idle", "event": "LeakageEnd", "guard": "true" }
  ],
  guards: [
    { "name": "InhibitAlarm", "condition": "inhibitAlarm" },
    { "name": "AcknowledgeAlarm", "condition": "acknowledgeAlarm" },
    { "name": "CancelAlarm", "condition": "cancelAlarm" },
    { "name": "ResetAlarm", "condition": "resetAlarm" },
    { "name": "SetAlarm", "condition": "setAlarm" },
    { "name": "FiredForBreaths", "condition": "firedForBreaths" },
    { "name": "FiredLeakage", "condition": "firedLeakage" }
  ]
}
}
```
